groups.name: Format
groups.group_explain: What kind of card this is — single character, multi-character group, scenario seed, world info, assistant, etc.

groups.name: Source Material
groups.group_explain: Where the character or world comes from — original creation, established IP, real-person fiction, or pop-culture reference.

groups.name: Content Rating
groups.group_explain: Overall content level — clean, suggestive, or explicit (sexual or violent).

groups.name: Narrative Tone
groups.group_explain: Emotional and genre flavor of the storytelling. Multiple may apply.

groups.name: User POV
groups.group_explain: Default narrative viewpoint — which gender or identity the card writes the user as.

groups.name: Target Pairing
groups.group_explain: Romantic or sexual orientation the card targets. Multiple may apply.

groups.name: Setting
groups.group_explain: Where and when the story takes place — historical era, fictional world, or scene type.

groups.name: Gender Presentation
groups.group_explain: The character's gender identity or presentation.

groups.name: Species
groups.group_explain: Species of the character — human, supernatural, anthro, monster, sci-fi entity.

groups.name: Body
groups.group_explain: Body shape, build, and physical features. Multiple may apply.

groups.name: Appearance Style
groups.group_explain: What the character typically wears — outfit type, uniform, formal/casual/fantasy garb.

groups.name: Ethnicity
groups.group_explain: Real-world ethnic origin or visual coding of the character (when relevant).

groups.name: Roles & Occupations
groups.group_explain: Job, role, or social position the character holds.

groups.name: Relationship Dynamic
groups.group_explain: How the character relates to the user — family, romantic, professional, antagonistic. Multiple may apply.

groups.name: Personality Archetypes
groups.group_explain: Personality type or character trope. Multiple may apply.

groups.name: Narrative Role
groups.group_explain: Narrative role — hero, villain, mentor, anti-hero, damsel.

groups.name: Established IP
groups.group_explain: Existing intellectual property — books, film, anime, games.

groups.name: Real Person Fiction
groups.group_explain: Fan-fiction based on real public figures.

groups.name: Anime & Manga
groups.group_explain: Specific anime or manga series.

groups.name: Computer Games
groups.group_explain: Specific video game titles.

groups.name: Fantasy
groups.group_explain: Fantasy sub-genre — high, urban, isekai, magical, dark fantasy.

groups.name: Sci-Fi
groups.group_explain: Science fiction sub-genre — cyberpunk, space opera, post-apocalyptic.

groups.name: Modern / Contemporary
groups.group_explain: Contemporary or real-world settings — slice of life, mystery, school, office.

groups.name: Demi-Human
groups.group_explain: Humanoids with animal traits — cat ears, fox tails, lamia, harpy. Mostly anime-inspired.

groups.name: Supernatural
groups.group_explain: Mythological or occult species — vampires, demons, angels, elves, gods.

groups.name: Monster
groups.group_explain: Generic monster characters when more specific species don't fit.

groups.name: Sci-Fi Entity
groups.group_explain: Non-supernatural non-human species — aliens, androids, cyborgs.

groups.name: Body Type
groups.group_explain: Overall build and silhouette — slim, curvy, muscular, petite, tall.

groups.name: Body Features
groups.group_explain: Visible features beyond basic build — hips, thighs, glasses, pregnancy.

groups.name: Bust Size
groups.group_explain: Bust prominence.

groups.name: Hair Color
groups.group_explain: Hair color.

groups.name: Hair Style
groups.group_explain: Hair length and cut.

groups.name: Eye Color
groups.group_explain: Eye color.

groups.name: Marks & Modifications
groups.group_explain: Skin features — freckles, moles, tattoos, piercings, scars.

groups.name: Professional & Uniforms
groups.group_explain: Job-coded uniforms — school, office lady, nurse, police, military.

groups.name: Casual & Everyday Wear
groups.group_explain: Regular daily clothing — casual, streetwear, sportswear, goth.

groups.name: Formal & Traditional
groups.group_explain: Dressy or traditional outfits — wedding dress, kimono, qipao.

groups.name: Fantasy & Stagewear
groups.group_explain: Costume, fantasy, and stage outfits — armor, magical girl, idol stage.

groups.name: Corporate & Office
groups.group_explain: Office hierarchy roles — boss, employee.

groups.name: Education
groups.group_explain: School and university roles — teacher, student.

groups.name: Medical Professionals
groups.group_explain: Healthcare roles — doctor, nurse.

groups.name: Service & Domestic
groups.group_explain: Domestic and religious service roles — maid, butler, nun, monk.

groups.name: Entertainment & Media
groups.group_explain: Performance and online creator roles — idol, streamer, VTuber.

groups.name: Combat & Law
groups.group_explain: Combat and security roles — knight, guard, mercenary, assassin.

groups.name: Underworld
groups.group_explain: Criminal roles — thief, mafia.

groups.name: High Society
groups.group_explain: Aristocratic roles — royalty, noble.

groups.name: Hostile / Cold
groups.group_explain: Cold, aggressive, or dismissive personality types — tsundere, kuudere, aloof.

groups.name: Obsessive / Dominant
groups.group_explain: Possessive, controlling, or sadistic personality types — yandere, manipulative, sadistic.

groups.name: Energetic / Positive
groups.group_explain: Outgoing, cheerful, confident personality types — genki, flirty, teasing.

groups.name: Quiet / Niche Tropes
groups.group_explain: Other softer personality types — shy, motherly, bookworm, depressed, cute.

tags.tag_explain: World-information document — defines setting lore (places, factions, events, rules). Not an interactive character; other cards reference it for consistency.
Eyes of two different colors (e.g. one blue, one green). Used as a striking visual trait.
Anime archetype: outwardly hostile, dismissive, or insulting toward their love interest while privately devoted. Affection masked as irritation.
Anime archetype: cool, stoic, and emotionally reserved on the surface; quietly affectionate underneath. Less hostile than tsundere.
Anime archetype: obsessively, possessively in love to a dangerous degree. Willing to harm rivals — or even the love interest — to keep the relationship.
Anime archetype: irrepressibly hyper, loud, energetic. Always upbeat, often clumsy, drives scenes with enthusiasm.
Anime archetype: extremely shy and silent in public; opens up sweetly to people they trust.
Anime archetype: noble/rich girl who demands princess treatment from everyone. Haughty and entitled, often hiding vulnerability.
Japanese youth subculture: heavy makeup, dyed hair, tan, party-girl attitude. Loud and fashion-conscious; often warm despite the look.
